subject: Activation steps and procurement packet for MicroGrid - DPA/SOC2/Subprocessors
messages:
From: Simon Liu <simon.liu@microgrid.energy>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Amelia Park <amelia.park@microgrid.energy>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding docs / next steps for MicroGrid activation

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for the demo earlier — we’re ready to proceed to procurement for the pilot. To get the legal and finance teams moving, can you confirm the following and send any required artifacts?

- DPA (final or template we can countersign)
- SOC 2 report or summary link we can share with our security team
- Current subprocessor inventory (any cloud infra or analytics partners)
- PO template and invoicing instructions (who to route the PO and invoices to)

Our procurement lead is Amelia (cc’d). We’re targeting a PO this week if everything’s in place. Also will need an approximate SLA/uptime statement for our SRE team — a 99.9% baseline is what we requested during the trial.

Attaching our supplier intake form separately.

Thanks,
Simon Liu
Head of Procurement | MicroGrid Energy
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Simon Liu <simon.liu@microgrid.energy>
Cc: Amelia Park <amelia.park@microgrid.energy>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding docs / next steps for MicroGrid activation

Hi Simon — great to hear you’re ready to move forward. I’ve put together the procurement packet below and attached the artifacts you asked for. High level next steps at the bottom.

Attachments included: MicroGrid_DPA_v1.0.pdf (DPA template, editable), subprocessor_inventory_202705.pdf (current list), PO_Template_MG.docx (standard Redwood PO fields). I also included a small text file with the SOC 2 summary link we provide to prospects.

SOC 2: https://redwood-inference.s3.amazonaws.com/soc2/redwood_soc2_summary_2027Q1.pdf (public summary; full attestation available under NDA or via secure share)
DPA: attached (we typically e-sign via DocuSign; link below)
DocuSign DPA template: https://app.docusign.com/templates/abcd-efgh-1234

PO / invoicing notes:
- Please send the signed PO to billing@redwood-inference.com (cc procurement@redwood-inference.com).
- Invoices should reference PO MG-2027-0432 and include the project code (MicroGrid Pilot).
- For faster processing, attach the PO PDF and a remit-to notice; we’ll process on a net-30 unless you requested alternative terms in the SOW.

Security/subprocessors: the attached inventory lists our cloud provider, monitoring, and metrics vendors and their data touchpoints. If your security team wants a short call to review the subprocessor controls, I can loop in our security lead.

SLA note: Our standard dedicated tier provides a 99.9% uptime SLA with credits for downtime; if you need a tailored SLA for pilot we can note exceptions in the SOW.

Next steps (recommended):
1) MicroGrid reviews the attached DPA and returns countersigned via DocuSign (I’ll pre-fill where possible).
2) Amelia or procurement sends the PO (use PO template we attached) to billing@redwood-inference.com with MG-2027-0432 in the subject.
3) Once DPA and PO are received we’ll activate billing and schedule onboarding (account creation, API keys, and a one-hour ops handoff).

If you want, Ben (cc’d) will take point on invoice routing/PO intake and Irene can triage any legal redlines.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Partner Success Manager | Redwood Inference
(Attachments: MicroGrid_DPA_v1.0.pdf, subprocessor_inventory_202705.pdf, PO_Template_MG.docx, Redwood_SOC2_Latest_Link.txt)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Simon Liu <simon.liu@microgrid.energy>, Amelia Park <amelia.park@microgrid.energy>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 11:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding docs / next steps for MicroGrid activation

Hi Simon / Amelia — quick note from finance to make the procurement path smoother. A few practical items we find help prevent delays:

- PO routing: Please email the signed PO PDF to billing@redwood-inference.com and cc procurement@redwood-inference.com. If you have a supplier portal upload, please include the HubSpot deal ID (MG-2027-0432) in the comments.
- Invoice format: PDF invoice, reference PO number, tax ID: 27-9846321, remit-to: Redwood Inference, 1101 Market St, San Francisco CA 94103.
- Payment terms: Default net-30; if you need net-15, indicate on the PO and we’ll request internal approval (may add a short processing time).
- If you plan to pay via ACH, include the bank reference line highlighted on the PO template; for wire transfers we’ll share account details after PO acceptance (for security we never email account numbers before PO is received).

Irene, if legal needs any redline guidance on the DPA I can coordinate with finance for the billing clause alignment.

Simon, if you want a single PDF with DPA + subprocessor list + SOC2 summary for your security review I can drop that into a secure share — let me know the email to send it to.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Simon Liu <simon.liu@microgrid.energy>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Amelia Park <amelia.park@microgrid.energy>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding docs / next steps for MicroGrid activation

Thanks Naomi / Ben — this is very helpful.

I’ve attached a draft PO (PO_MicroGrid_0432_draft.pdf) and a signed supplier intake form. We’ll sign the DPA via the DocuSign link you shared if there are no material redlines.

Two quick clarifications:
- Can you confirm the address and tax ID Ben listed for the invoice? I will copy that verbatim into our PO.
- For the subprocessor inventory, is there any partner that has access to raw customer content? Our security team flagged that as a gating item.

If we can get confirmation on both by EOD Monday we’ll route the PO and request net-30 payment. Appreciate the quick turnaround — our program manager would like to begin onboarding the week of June 7.

Simon Liu
Head of Procurement | MicroGrid Energy
